contracts.blurb: Noodles and soap for West Africa, one container a week.
Bar soap with an East Africa label for 400 shops.
Noodles for the north, collected at the Kano plant gate.
Bar soap by the truckload for Ariaria traders.
Bottled water and fruit drink for weddings and conferences.
Noodles and soap on European shelves after a full audit.

belt.name: Roller Conveyor
belt.blurb: Rolls raw goods from the delivery bay to one production line without carrying.

auto.name: Auto Fill-and-Seal Line
auto.blurb: Makes and bags products by itself; one operator watches three lines.

pack.name: Robot Palletiser
pack.blurb: Stacks cartons on pallets and a forklift takes them to the gate.

milestones.title: Second Plant
milestones.blurb: A second sealing hall opens. Same clean water, same blue bag.

milestones.title: Five Plants
milestones.blurb: Omi-Ola trucks are a common sight across Lagos and Ogun.

milestones.title: North and East
milestones.blurb: Kano makes noodles, Aba makes soap, each with its own manager.

milestones.title: Every Region
milestones.blurb: A plant near every big market cuts the trucking bill.

milestones.title: Training School
milestones.blurb: The old backyard shed now trains young technicians.

milestones.title: Across Africa
milestones.blurb: Tema and Nairobi plants pass their first quality audits.

milestones.title: Gas Power Everywhere
milestones.blurb: Every plant runs on grid and gas. The generators rest.

milestones.title: Sold Abroad
milestones.blurb: Containers leave for Europe every week. Mama cuts the ribbon.

staff: Lab test done, water is clean.
Stack the cartons five high, no more.
Hair nets on before you enter.
Pulp drums are cold, store is fine.
Palm oil tanker at the gate.
Scrap nylon bagged for the recycler.
customer: Ten bags of sachet water, please.
Can I pay in 7 days like last time?
Your water tastes clean, my customers like it.
Do you have bottled water for a wedding?
Two cartons of fruit drink for my shop.
Noodles for my stall in the market.
I paid my invoice on time, oga.
Is the soap the same as last month?
Crystal Peak is cheaper, but yours is cleaner.
I need a receipt for my records.
manager: Diesel is low. Shall I fill the tank?
Grid was on most of today.
Two distributors paid early this week.
Line three needs a service soon.
The waste bin is half full. Recycler comes Friday.
night: Service the machines before they cry.
Count the stock, then count the cash.
Clean water is the whole business.
Collect what you are owed before you borrow.
Buy nylon on a cheap week.
A good fitter saves whole afternoons.

events.name: Heat Wave
events.text: Sun dey hot die! Sachet and bottled water sell fast today.

events.name: Grid Collapse
events.text: No light all day. The generator drinks diesel and costs rise.

events.name: Owambe Weekend
events.text: Three big parties order bottled water and fruit drink in bulk.

events.name: Surprise Inspection
events.text: Inspector Bisi checks the hand-wash point and logbook. A clean factory earns a quality bonus.

events.name: Nylon Price Jump
events.text: Nylon rolls cost more this week. Use your stored stock if you have it.

events.name: Sealing Machine Jams
events.text: A line slows until the fitter repairs it. Did you service it?

events.name: Palm Oil Harvest
events.text: Plenty palm oil in the east. Tankers arrive quickly today.

events.name: Copied Label
events.text: Someone is copying your label. You report it and add a security seal; some buyers wait to be sure.

mech.name: Hand carry
mech.how: Nylon rolls and sacks carried in both arms from the store to the line

mech.name: Hand trolley
mech.how: Loader pushes a two-wheel trolley stacked with cartons to the gate

mech.name: Roller conveyor
mech.how: Rolls goods along steel rollers on green legs from the bay to the line

mech.name: Delivery truck
mech.how: Omi-Ola truck backs to the dock, loaders fill it carton by carton

mech.name: Electric forklift
mech.how: Small forklift lifts pallets from the palletiser to the warehouse

mech.name: Container trailer
mech.how: Trailers carry sealed containers from the docks to the Lagos port

storyNote: Story follows plan2/factory.json. Inspectors are honest and never paid off; no registration numbers are shown or invented. Waste nylon goes to a licensed recycler.
